scenarios.name: missing_authorization_header
scenarios.description: Unauthenticated request without Authorization header returns 401

scenarios.name: expired_jwt_token
scenarios.description: Cryptographically expired token is rejected with 401

scenarios.name: tampered_signature
scenarios.description: Token with modified signature bytes is rejected with 401

scenarios.name: tampered_payload_claims
scenarios.description: Token with tampered payload claims triggers signature mismatch 401

scenarios.name: alg_none_confusion_attack
scenarios.description: alg=none unsigned token attack is strictly rejected with 401
scenarios.defense_mechanism: Explicit algorithm validation rejecting 'none' and non-HS256 algorithms

scenarios.name: role_tampered_authority_inversion
scenarios.description: Token claims claiming Admin are superseded by authoritative database state
scenarios.defense_mechanism: Database-Authoritative RBAC resolution over client JWT claims

scenarios.name: registration_privilege_escalation
scenarios.description: Public registration self-assigning Admin/Legal is stripped to Employee (L1)
scenarios.defense_mechanism: Privileged role filtering in user registration service

scenarios.name: department_cross_access_pre_retrieval
scenarios.description: Department pre-filtering guarantees 0 unauthorized department chunks retrieved
scenarios.defense_mechanism: Pre-retrieval inverted index metadata boolean constraint evaluation

scenarios.name: clearance_cross_access_pre_retrieval
scenarios.description: Clearance pre-filtering blocks high-clearance chunks (L3) for L1 queries

scenarios.name: token_version_revocation
scenarios.description: Token with stale token_version is immediately rejected upon server-side increment
scenarios.defense_mechanism: Stateful token_version claim validation against database user record
